messages:
kai_csm: Quick heads-up — NewTide Labs needs a short, auditable config change for a live investor demo tomorrow. Ask: temporary QPS increase on /v1/generate + allowlist a single CIDR, region preference = eu-east-1, auto-revoke after window. This demo factors into an imminent renewal / potential Dedicated upsell. Can ops help ASAP?

nora_support: Ack. Please paste CIDR, org id, exact routes, uplift factor, start/end times, and contact. Also flagging @ash_eng for security sign-off.

NewTide_OPS: Org: org_newtide_23. CIDR: 203.0.113.128/32. Routes: /v1/generate only. Uplift: 2x. Window: 2025-11-05T10:30:00Z -> 2025-11-05T11:30:00Z (60m). Auto-revoke: yes. Contact: demoops@newtide.ai. They also asked for an audit tag: initiated_by=kai_csm;reason=investor-demo.

ben_oncall: Plan: 1) add proxy ACL entry, 2) apply region_pin soft to eu-east-1 (fallback allowed), 3) set per-route qps_override=2.0 for org_newtide_23, 4) schedule auto-revoke. Tagging @ash_eng for quick IP/residency check.

ash_eng: Quick review — CIDR looks like partner test range, approved. Two suggestions: cap concurrency for /v1/generate to 900 to avoid noisy-neighbor OOMs; and restrict ACL to route-level if the proxy supports route-scoped ACLs. Otherwise good to go.

nora_support: Running staging patch and smoke now. Staging command:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_newtide_23 \
  --patch '{"region_pin":"eu-east-1","routes":{"/v1/generate":{"qps_override":2.0,"concurrency_cap":900}},"acls":["203.0.113.128/32"]}' \
  --region eu-east-1 --expires 2025-11-05T11:30:00Z --audit "initiated_by=kai_csm;reason=investor-demo"
```

nora_support: Staging smoke OK, pushing to eu-east-1 in ~90s. Console: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/org_newtide_23/policies

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-11-04T18:05:12Z actor=nora_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=nora_support status=success time=2025-11-04T18:07:02Z ref=patch-130211

ben_oncall: Verified ACL + soft region pin + qps_override live in eu-east-1. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-11-05T11:30:00Z. I'll monitor p50/p95 and error rate during the window and report anomalies here.

NewTide_OPS: Warmup traffic looks steady. Appreciate the audit note. If demo converts we'd like a follow-up on Dedicated pricing, SLA tiers, and guidance for sustained pre-warming.

kai_csm: Noted — adding to renewal tracker and scheduling a post-demo technical review if they convert. Thanks team for the fast turnaround :raised_hands:
